representation: multilingual-e5-small pinned semantic-pilot-v1 revision; query prefix, masked mean, L2, float32, max_length 512
maintenance: same full warmup for every method; cap stops future insertions once leaf CF count >= budget, including warmup already at budget; rolling rebuild after every 2048 scored arrivals using last 2048 learned rows, each row once
prediction: all day predictions before any learning in that day; warmup and day updates chronological one row at a time
metrics: per-day STORY and CATEGORY ARI, primary all and secondary first normalized title since warmup, row-weighted daily means (not pooled cross-window ARI); <2 rows returns null; singleton labels use sklearn definition
information_budget: no labels in representation, sampling, fitting, maintenance or parameter choice; no threshold tuning; 128 cap is a prespecified small-budget sensitivity
timing: separate encoding from clustering; fresh process per method, one numerical thread; no JIT; all maintenance included; process RSS includes vectors and imports, not encoder
identity: within-window ARI only; no persistent cross-window identity claim
